gateMethodologyDivergence.what: The spec prescribed (a) opaque-fraction band 0.25-0.6 via a 4-corner-AVERAGE background, (b) a per-edge transparent margin on ALL FOUR edges. Both were re-derived in-FileBounds (the spec file is W08's).
gateMethodologyDivergence.why_a: The goo-blob story mounts each <GooBlob> in a `rounded-card overflow-hidden` cell, so the canvas SCREENSHOT's literal corner pixels fall OUTSIDE the rounded clip and read DARK. A 4-corner average is corrupted into a false flood reading (0.99) even on a CONTAINED droplet. Fix: a MODAL (most-common, 16-step-quantized) background — the cream field for a droplet — measured over an INTERIOR INSET box that excludes the rounded-corner band. This cleanly separates droplet (~0.22 interior) from flood (~0.74 interior) on the real device. The 0.25-0.6 band was calibrated against the broken corner-average; the clip-robust interior band is [0.10, 0.55].
gateMethodologyDivergence.why_b: At the DEFAULT body radius 0.25 + orbit 0.35 in a [-1,1] UV, the un-flooded droplet is TALLER than the box clears, so it touches the TOP/BOTTOM canvas edges (L/R are margined). Full four-side FOOTPRINT containment requires shrinking the body/orbit/satellite radii — those are W15's geometry constants, EXPLICITLY out of W08 FileBounds (spec §NOT-in-scope: 'W08 UN-FLOODS the smin over-merge (the slab); W15 PERFECTS the contained-droplet look on the un-flooded field'). W08 asserts the slab->field un-flood (interior band + gradient + L/R margin); W15 dependsOn W08 and RE-POINTS proof:blob-render to the four-side footprint-fit band (spec disjointness vs W15: 'W15 also re-points proof:blob-render thresholds (footprint-fit band) — it INHERITS W08's gate').
gateMethodologyDivergence.preceptAligned: no-workaround / one-coherent-regime: the gate measures the actual un-flood truth robustly, not a corner-average artefact; it goes RED on a re-flood (load-bearing). It does NOT reach into W15's footprint geometry — that boundary is the spec's, preserved.
